tagline: Build the person you want to become.
pillars: Digital Self-Control (managing screen time, distractions, and digital boundaries)
Discipline and Focus (building consistency, attention, and intentional routines)
Behavioural Awareness (understanding triggers, impulses, and habit loops)
Recovery and Personal Growth (recovering from setbacks without shame or guilt)
Accountability (taking ownership and tracking meaningful progress)
Intentional Living (aligning daily digital choices with long-term goals)
tone_rules: Use British English spelling strictly (e.g., behaviour, focus, intentionality, programme).
Never use guilt, shame, fear-based messaging, or aggressive marketing.
Never use fake excitement, exclamation mark spam, or excessive emojis (max 1 subtle symbol if needed, or zero).
Never fabricate Qur'anic quotes, Hadith, religious rulings, user statistics, or unverified claims.
Do not advertise specific app features as live; focus on universal behavioural value and NŪR's core philosophy.
visual_style: Premium minimalist editorial photography and clean architectural/human-centred scenes. Colour palette dominated by deep forest green (#0B5D3B), matte charcoal (#1C1C1C), warm ivory (#F5F0E1), and subtle muted gold lighting (#D4AF37). Generous negative space, calm atmosphere, modern technology aesthetic, zero neon colours, zero clutter, zero text inside the image.
